---
title: "PointCoordinate"
format: html
---

`PointCoordinate` is a TransformsV2 container transform that projects one coordinate component from `PointData` into `RaggedAnalogTimeSeries`.

## Signature

```text
PointData -> RaggedAnalogTimeSeries
```

Parameters:

```cpp
struct PointCoordinateParams {
    PointCoordinateComponent coordinate{PointCoordinateComponent::X};
};
```

`coordinate` selects `X` or `Y`.

## Semantics

For every time point in the input `PointData`, the transform emits one float value per point at that time:

```text
PointData[t] = [(x1, y1), (x2, y2)]
PointCoordinate(X)[t] = [x1, x2]
PointCoordinate(Y)[t] = [y1, y2]
```

The output preserves the input `TimeFrame`.

## TensorDesign Use

For single-keypoint-per-time data, `PointCoordinate` can be sampled directly by timestamp or TimeFrame row providers:

```json
{
  "name": "nose_x",
  "source_key": "Nose",
  "pipeline_json": "{\"steps\": [{\"step_id\": \"x\", \"transform_name\": \"PointCoordinate\", \"parameters\": {\"coordinate\": \"X\"}}]}"
}
```

For interval rows, use a terminal range reduction after coordinate projection:

```json
{
  "name": "mean_nose_x",
  "source_key": "Nose",
  "pipeline_json": "{\"steps\": [{\"step_id\": \"x\", \"transform_name\": \"PointCoordinate\", \"parameters\": {\"coordinate\": \"X\"}}], \"range_reduction\": {\"reduction_name\": \"MeanValue\"}}"
}
```

Timestamp sampling of `RaggedAnalogTimeSeries` currently uses the first value at a time point. This is intended for single-keypoint-per-time `PointData`. Multi-point-per-time data should use an explicit reduction or future sampling policy before being treated as a single scalar column.
